description: This file implements functionalities for managing Git repositories, including cloning, parsing URLs, validating package structure, and updating installation registry. It is part of a package management or deployment system within the project.

classes.name: GitPackageInfo
classes.description: Represents parsed Git package information including URL, reference (branch/tag), and clone URL.

classes.name: GitInstaller
classes.description: Handles Git package installation, including cloning repositories and validating structure.

methods.name: newSpinner
methods.description: Creates a new spinner object for indicating progress.

methods.name: InstallFromGit
methods.description: Main method to clone, validate, and install a package from a Git repository.

methods.name: cloneRepository
methods.description: Clones the Git repository with options for branch/tag and shallow clone.

methods.name: findPackageRoot
methods.description: Locates the root directory of the package containing 'agentfield-package.yaml'.

methods.name: updateRegistryWithGit
methods.description: Updates the local installation registry with information about the Git source and package details.
